author: @jeremyfowers

evidence.api_compatibility: No breaking API change. The change is internal to the server's HTTP client behavior. The default stall window changes from 120s to 600s, which is a behavioral shift but does not alter any documented contract, config schema, CLI command, or external API.
evidence.documentation: The PR author checked 'Documentation is not affected by this change' and the diff touches only code and tests — no docs files were modified.
evidence.manual_release_testing: The default stall window changes from 120s to 600s, which directly affects the user-visible behavior of long prefill operations. The author provided test logs showing a 32768-token prefill surviving past 200s (previously killed at 120s) and a 6144-token prefill correctly aborting at 20s when global_timeout=20 is set. These should be confirmed against release artifacts before tagging.
evidence.post_approval_commits: No commits were added after approval. The three branch commits (bug fix, refactoring for a single silence rule, and credit to prior work from #3447/#3471) were all authored and committed before @Geramy's approval at 2026-09-01T20:11:55Z.
evidence.review: One approval from @Geramy (maintainer with subject-matter expertise in sockets/tcp/ip) who confirmed that CURLOPT_LOW_SPEED_LIMIT can be set independently of other low-speed options. No inline comments were raised. The review was brief but subject-matter relevant.
evidence.security: No security concern. The change modifies curl timeout options (CURLOPT_LOW_SPEED_TIME) to use the configured default timeout instead of a hardcoded value. No new network paths, credential handling, code execution, or supply-chain changes.
evidence.tests: Adds a new test in test/cpp/test_http_client_timeout.cpp that sets default_timeout to 2 seconds, calls post_stream on a silent endpoint with timeout_seconds=0, and verifies the call returns within the ceiling. This proves the stall window now respects the configured default timeout. All CI checks passed (C++ unit tests, C++ server build, CodeQL, container builds).

maintainer_todos.text: Manually verify that long-prefill operations on large models with long prompts no longer get killed at the old 120s boundary and respect the configured global_timeout.

subject: fix(server): streaming stall window follows global_timeout (#3386) (#3477)
summary: Changes the streaming stall window from a hardcoded 120-second bound to the configured global_timeout, preventing large prefill operations from being killed mid-generation.
verdict_reason: The change alters server-side streaming behavior (default stall window jumps from 120s to 600s) and should be manually verified before release to confirm long-prefill scenarios no longer terminate prematurely.
